| # Cyclic Memory check {#cyclic-memory-check-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The function monitors the memory areas of the function monitoring. The following monitoring functions are performed:

- Double storage with value and complement (complement test)

  Within the function monitoring, all variables and bits used in the next run or in the time−based subsequent modules are stored twice as value and complement.

- Cyclical RAM test (writeability test)

- Cyclic checksum of the postbuild pointers

- Cyclical ROM test (checksum test)

- Cyclical Stack test (writeability test)

- Cyclical CSA test (writeability test)

- Asynchronous stack/CSA test (writeability test)

- Single 32−/16−/8−Bit Test (writability test)

 

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- It is not possible to assure a stable system run after appearance of a RAM error. Because of this reason, system will be reset immediately in case of a RAM failure detection.

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:

  Error                            Reaction
  -------------------------------- ------------------------------------
  DFC                              no
  Error Code                       no
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)     Yes
  ECU Reset                        Yes
  Reaction time                    2 seconds
  Reset Reason  - Reset Group ID   RESET_SWRESET_MOC
  Reset Reason  - Reset number     RESET_SWRESET_MOCMEM_CHKRAM_FAILED
